
### sequence numbers  {.smaller}


* call the ‘part’ label <i>sequence number</i> 

   * for now: sequence number = message (or <i>segment</i>) number
   * in TCP: sequence number = byte number
 
<hr class="vspace" />
* important question: how large can they get?
* if we never reuse them --- infinite!
* so <i>really</i> want to reuse them


### 1-bit sequence number 

![](/reliable-stop/texfig/1bit-seq-num-1-bit-sequence-number.figure.svg)


### ‘stop and wait’ 


* machine A is only sending <em>one thing at a time</em>
* never start sending next thing until after sending previous thing


### stop-and-wait exercise (receive, 1)  {.smaller}



* machine B receives <tt class="box"><em>0</em>: X</tt>
* machine B sends <tt class="box">ACK <em>0</em></tt>
* machine B receives <tt class="box"><em>0</em>: X</tt> 
<hr class="vspace" />
* what should machine B do now?
 <table>
<tr><td>A. send <tt class="box">ACK <em>0</em></tt></td><td>B. send <tt class="box">ACK <em>1</em></tt></td><td>C. send nothing</td></tr>
<tr><td></td></tr>
</table>

### stop-and-wait exercise (send, 1)  {.smaller}



* A trying to send ‘X’, then ‘Y’, then ‘Z’
* machine A sends <tt class="box"><em>0</em>: X</tt>
* machine A sends <tt class="box"><em>0</em>: X</tt>
* machine A receives <tt class="box">ACK <em>0</em></tt>
* machine A sends <tt class="box"><em>1</em>: Y</tt>
* machine A receives <tt class="box">ACK <em>0</em></tt> 
<hr class="vspace" />
* what should machine A do now?
 <table>
<tr><td>A. send <tt class="box">0: X</tt> again</td><td>B. send <tt class="box">1: Y</tt> again</td></tr>
<tr><td>C. send <tt class="box">0: Z</tt></td><td>D. something else</td></tr>
<tr><td></td></tr>
</table>
